sections.release_notes:
## :star: New Features

- Make `SourceHttpMessageConverter` optional [#29535](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29535)
- Deprecate `LocalVariableTableParameterNameDiscoverer` completely (avoiding its exposure in native images) [#29531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29531)
- Make GeneratorStrategy.generate unreachable on native [#29521](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29521)
- Update `LogAdapter` to allow build-time code removal [#29506](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29506)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Unhandled exceptions should mark Servlet observation outcome as error [#29512](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29512)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Broken link in documentation section 6.10 [#29554](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29554)
- Fix Javadoc link text in BindingResult [#29551](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29551)
- Fix some typos in Kotlin WebClient example code [#29538](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29538)
- Fix link to Bean Utils Light Library in BeanUtils Javadoc [#29534](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29534)
- Fix link to WebFlux section in reference manual [#29525](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29525)
- Document RuntimeHints testing strategies [#29523](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29523)
- Reorganize and modularize the Testing chapter in the reference manual [#29522](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29522)
- Document switch to `SQLExceptionSubclassTranslator` in the upgrade guide [#29518](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29518)
- Update documentation to mention Java 17+ baseline [#29514](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29514)
- Link to Spring WebFlux section is broken [#29513](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29513)
- Update javadoc of Jackson-based decoders to reflect 2.14 baseline [#29508](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29508)
- Code example has callout from a different code example [#29505](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29505)
- Code listing callouts are displayed incorrectly in core-beans.adoc [#29457](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29457)
- Fix a syntax error in an XML listing in core-validation.adoc [#29456](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29456)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Jackson 2.14.1 [#29539](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29539)
- Upgrade to Kotlin 1.7.21 [#29543](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29543)
